transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I came in because my eating has just gotten all turned around lately. It's been going on for months now, actually. Some days I just... I just pick at a piece of toast and have some coffee, and that's it. But then other days, I'll find myself standing in the bakery aisle at the grocery store, buying all these sweets that I don't even really enjoy eating. It's just... I don't know, it's not normal for me, and I figured I should probably talk to someone about it.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight over the past few months?

I haven't really been keeping track of the scale, to be honest. Like I was just saying, my eating is just so all over the place right now. Between the days I barely eat anything but toast, and the days I'm buying all those sweets... my appetite is just completely turned around. So I'm not sure if I've actually lost a significant amount of weight, just that my eating habits have been completely off for months now.
Do you ever eat a large amount of food in a short period of time, feeling like you can't stop?

No, I don't really do that. Even when I buy all those sweets, I don't sit down and eat them all at once or anything. I might just have a little bit, or honestly, sometimes they just sit on the counter. I never feel like I'm out of control or stuffing myself... it's just that I'm buying things I wouldn't normally buy.
Do you often feel guilty after eating?

No, I wouldn't say I feel guilty. I mean... I know my eating habits are all messed up right now, but I don't feel bad about myself after I actually do eat something. Whether it's just that piece of toast or a little bit of a sweet, it's just... food. I don't really have any strong feelings about it either way. So, no, guilt isn't really something I've noticed.
Do you worry about gaining weight?
No, not really. I mean, I guess I don't really think about it much. With everything else going on, my weight just isn't something I'm focused on or worried about.
Are you afraid of becoming fat?
No, I'm not afraid of that. It's just not something that crosses my mind right now.
Do you notice that your unusual eating habits tend to happen when you're feeling stressed or emotional?

No, I haven't noticed any connection like that. My eating habits are just... off all the time lately, regardless of how stressed I am. It doesn't seem to be tied to my emotions or anything specific going on. I just don't have much of an appetite in general right now.
Do you find that you have less interest in food in general lately?

Well, yes and no. That's actually why I came in, because my eating has just gotten all turned around for months now. Some days I have zero interest and just pick at toast and coffee. But then other days, I'll end up standing in the bakery aisle buying all these sweets that I don't even really enjoy. It's just completely mixed up.
Do you think you would enjoy eating if you were in a different situation or environment?

I don't really think so. I mean, it's not about where I am or who I'm with. The feeling—or lack of it—just stays the same no matter the situation. It's just... I don't know, it's just how it is for me right now.
Do you think your lack of interest in food is related to any emotional or psychological issues you're experiencing?

I honestly don't know. I mean, I know I haven't been feeling right lately, but... I haven't really noticed a direct connection between how I'm feeling emotionally and the food stuff. It just feels like my appetite is broken all on its own, really. I guess I just can't say for sure if one is causing the other.
Do you think there's anything going on emotionally or psychologically that's contributing to your lack of interest in food?

Um, like I was just saying... I really don't know. I mean, I know my mood hasn't been great, but I don't really see a clear line between my emotions and my stomach. It just feels like my appetite sort of turned off on its own. So... no, I can't really say if one is causing the other. I just haven't noticed a connection like that.
Do you think your eating habits would go back to normal if your mood improved?

I'm really not sure if it would go back to normal. I actually came in because my eating has just gotten all turned around, and it's been like this for months now. It's not just a lack of interest... some days I just pick at a piece of toast and have coffee, but then other days I find myself standing in the bakery aisle buying all these sweets that I don't even really enjoy eating. It's just all over the place.
Do you think your lack of interest in eating is related to feeling depressed?

I... I really don't know. Like I've been saying, I just haven't noticed a connection like that. I know I'm feeling down, and I know my eating is a mess, but I just can't tell you if the depression is what's causing it. They both just feel like things I'm dealing with right now, and I really can't say if one is triggering the other.
Do you think your eating habits would change if you weren't feeling down?

I honestly don't know. Like I was trying to say before, I just can't predict if my appetite would fix itself if my mood got better. It's just... I can't really tell if they're tied together like that. I just know my eating is completely off right now, and I don't know what it would take to get it back to normal.
Do you think your eating habits are related to any other psychological issues you're experiencing besides feeling down?

I'm not really sure about that either. I haven't noticed my eating habits tying into anything else going on in my head. It's just... my appetite is all over the place, and I don't know what's driving it. I just know it's not normal for me.
Do you think your lack of interest in eating is related to any psychological issue you are experiencing?

I really can't say if it's tied to anything in my head. I just know I originally came in because my eating has gotten all turned around for months now. It's just strange... some days I'll just pick at toast and have coffee, and then other days I'll find myself standing in the bakery aisle buying sweets that I don't even really enjoy eating. It's just completely out of whack.
Do you think there's something going on in your mind that's causing you to not want to eat normally?

Like I just mentioned, I really don't know what's causing it or if it's in my mind. I just know that the main reason I came in is because my eating has been completely turned around for months now. It's exactly what I was just saying... some days I'll just pick at a piece of toast and have some coffee, and other days I'm just standing there in the bakery aisle buying sweets I don't even really enjoy. I just don't know the reason behind why I'm doing it.
Do you think your lack of interest in eating is due to not finding food enjoyable anymore?

I don't think it's about the taste, no. Food still tastes the same as it always did. It's just... the desire to eat it isn't there most days. Like I was saying, it's not about whether I enjoy it or not, I just don't have the drive to eat a normal meal anymore.
Do you think there is something going on in your life or mind that is causing these changes in your eating habits?

I feel like I keep saying the same thing, but... I really just don't know. I wish I could give you a clear reason or point to something specific going on in my life right now, but I honestly can't. I just don't have an explanation for why it's happening.
Is there something specific on your mind that you think might be affecting your eating habits?

Doctor, I... I really don't know how else to say it. I've been trying to answer this, but there just isn't anything specific on my mind that I can point to. I'm not hiding anything, I just... I honestly don't know why this is happening.
